text.trigger: A survivor of yours searches the Library.
text.vignette: Behind a locked grille in the rare-books room sits a huge, dusty volume with a title that makes your skin crawl. You carry it out like a holy relic and call the whole colony together for the unveiling.

options.laugh: It turns out to be a band biography and the colony howls with laughter. Morale rises by 1.
options.throwIt: Drop it out of a window onto a passing zombie. One zombie at the Library dies and its courier bag holds four food tokens.
